title: Text keeps every word at every zoom
goal: At some zoom levels the last word of a line disappears from the canvas: a one line subtitle that fits its box wraps at that zoom and its second line is cut off. Words on the canvas should read the same at every zoom.
notes: Found by ask-on-the-local-model-makes-results-that-look-f, 2026-11-03, seen in the pricing walk at Next defaults (queue/audits/2026-11-03-ask-layout-look-after-sc.png: the subtitle ends at cancel). Shared renderer, so it was not fixed there: that task may not change Current. TextRasterizer.rasterize (Sources/PhotonzRender/TextRasterizer.swift) sets width = Int((size.width * scale).rounded()) and lays out in CGRect(width: CGFloat(width) / scale), so a rounded-down pixel width narrows the layout box below the measured one; the doc comment above it promises line breaks are identical at every scale. Fix to try: lay out in size, not pixels / scale. Reproduced with a throwaway Swift test: naturalSize 526 x 26 for that line (SF Pro 18 regular, alignment center), then rasterize at each scale and measure ink width. Output: scale 1.0 pixels 526 layout 526.0 ink 519.0; scale 2.0 pixels 1052 layout 526.0 ink 520.0; scale 0.6715 pixels 353 layout 525.689 ink 445.3; scale 1.343 pixels 706 layout 525.689 ink 447.5; scale 1.25 pixels 658 layout 526.4 ink 520.0; scale 1.7 pixels 894 layout 525.882 ink 519.4. Cut at 0.6715 and 1.343 only. A move is not the cause: the same line placed by add_text and moved with set_layer shows every word in render_picture at 100%.
acceptance: The line "Simple plans that scale with you. No hidden fees, cancel anytime." at 18 pt, centred in the box it was measured for, shows every word at 67% window zoom on a 2x screen
A test proves a line breaks in the same place at every render scale, across scales whose pixel width rounds down
The change reaches Next, and text drawn at 100% does not move

log.note: digest 2026-11-04 spot check: confirmed, stays p1. The picture named in the notes (queue/audits/2026-11-03-ask-layout-look-after-sc.png) ends the subtitle at cancel. A CoreText check with the system font at 18 pt: the line needs 521.81 pt; a box of 521.76 pt (522 pt rounded to pixels at scale 1.7) wraps it to 2 lines, and boxes of 521.97 pt or wider keep 1. Which scales fail depends on the font and the width, so test by rounding down rather than only at the two scales in the notes.
triage 2026-11-10: unchanged, still second in p1 after the user's story task and the CI fix.

Reproduced first: new test TextBreaksAtEveryScaleTests failed 28 times (ink 447 pt wide against 520 at 100%, the last word gone) and the reveal's word pieces counted 10 of 11 at 0.6715 and 1.343. In the probe, the new walk at 64% on this 2x screen showed the line ending at 'cancel' on the old renderer.

Fix: TextRasterizer.layoutBox lays the words out in the measured size (top pinned to the picture's top) instead of pixels / scale; used by rasterize and by revealPieces (TextRevealRasterizer), which had the same rounding. Word rects and plateRect already used the true size, so they now agree with the picture at every scale.

Chose laying out in the true box over rounding pixels up because the canvas places the picture at pixels / bake, so only the layout box needed to change; image sizes are untouched. 100% check: 108 scale-1 renders (3 strings x 3 alignments x 3 vertical x 4 box sizes) hashed before/after: every whole-point box identical; fractional boxes move at most 0.48 px across and 1 px down for middle/bottom (sitting in their true box).

Verified: Scripts/test.sh exit 0 (all runs passed); walk text-keeps-every-word-at-every-zoom-walk ok with 3 real captures; looked at 3-at-64 before/after crops: before ends at 'cancel', after ends at 'anytime.'. Release current: shared renderer, so Next has it with no port.

Text rasterizer (still and reveal) lays words out in the measured box, not pixels / scale, so a line that fits never wraps at a zoom whose pixel width rounds down (commit 6bffae84a, shared renderer, so Current and Next). Verified: TextBreaksAtEveryScaleTests over 30+ rounding-down scales incl. 0.6715 and 1.343; walk text-keeps-every-word-at-every-zoom-walk at 64% on a 2x screen ends at 'anytime.' where the old renderer ended at 'cancel'; whole-point boxes at 100% byte-identical; Scripts/test.sh green.
